title: Reject zero or negative quantities in sales
request: Sales accept zero or negative quantities. A sale with qty -3 increases stock by 3 and records negative revenue. A sale must be rejected when any line has a quantity of zero or less. Reject it with an OperationError before any stock is changed or any document is written. Valid sales must keep working. Relevant code: Operations.sell, Operations._sell and Operations._sell_product in operations.py.
